flow.hint: Live mode: select at least two direct workspace switches. The panel closes and shortcuts stay enabled. The bar checks actual workspace changes, not keystrokes. Green = target reached, red = other workspace. Click the trainer to stop.
workspace.name: Custom workspace name, e.g. Terminal (empty = default)
title: Shortcut trainer
hint: Press the displayed combination. Escape or clicking outside ends practice. Normal shortcut actions are blocked during practice (except media keys).
capture.unavailable: Shortcut inhibition is not active yet — please do not press shortcuts.
selection.title: Select shortcuts
selection.hint: Check individual shortcuts or entire groups. Groups are assigned automatically. Your selection is saved. Group checkboxes also apply to hidden search results.
selection.empty: No shortcuts selected. Open the selection.
